indications.trial_design: Planned Phase II based on completed JHU-sponsored Phase I open-label dose-escalation in 24 newly diagnosed glioma patients with adjuvant temozolomide (NCT01729260 — completed; no DLT observed; not BullFrog-sponsored)

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: BullFrog AI is primarily an AI/ML drug-development services platform (bfLEAP). It has not yet initiated any company-sponsored clinical trials. Its lead therapeutic asset (improved mebendazole formulation, JHU license) is described as 'Phase II ready' but no Phase II is currently enrolling. BF-223 (glioblastoma) is preclinical/IND-enabling. SPTBN1 siRNA program (GWU license, HCC/NASH/obesity) is preclinical.
